free_tier.stated: A permanently free Basic shield, then plan-based tiers that add bandwidth, domains, backends and advanced protection.

egress.terms: No byte figure is published for the free Basic shield: 'Plan limits and exact pricing are shown in the order process on our panel.'; ingress: tcp

interface_detail: Self-serve panel at panel.neoprotect.net; API keys are a plan-based feature.
tooling: DNS record in the panel, no client or plugin to install
chaining: Point a domain at the shield and keep the origin hidden; no tunnel or agent, so it needs a public origin rather than composing with a private VM.

limits.value: the free Basic shield is '1 GameShield, Minecraft Java'; Bedrock / Geyser protection is listed only on the plan-based tier
the default RakNet port 19132 requires at least the Neo plan and a Discord ticket

binding_note: The free Basic shield carries no UDP port at all, so no byte allowance is ever reached: the gate is the plan tier. Bedrock is the paid product, and the vendor's own docs put it behind a paid plan plus a ticket for port 19132.

identity_cost.detail: An account at panel.neoprotect.net. The register form was not opened, so the required fields are unread.

reliability_note: Bedrock traffic on the paid tier needs both TCP and UDP open from NeoProtect's published IP list; the default 19132 allocation is manual.
confidence_note: The free-tier contents and the Bedrock gating are quoted from first-party pages. What the free shield's actual bandwidth allowance is would only come from the order flow behind a login.

evidence.proved: The Basic free plan is '1 GameShield, Minecraft Java'; 'Bedrock / Geyser protection' appears only under the plan-based tier, and voice proxies only under Enterprise
Protecting Bedrock players requires a paid plan, and the default 19132 port requires at least the Neo plan; 19132 UDP is RakNet and 19132 TCP is NetherNet
Plan limits and exact pricing are shown in the order process on the panel

notes: The free shield is real and permanently free, but it is Java/TCP plus DNS, so it fails UDP test on the free tier. The Bedrock path does carry UDP 19132 and a WebRTC UDP port, on paid tiers.

extras.wg_detail: No WireGuard offering, and the free tier publishes no UDP port to put one behind.
extras.volume_stated: No byte figure is published for the free Basic shield: 'Plan limits and exact pricing are shown in the order process on our panel.'
extras.transit_note: NeoProtect's GameShield edge proxies the game traffic
